notes.title: PROJECT MIX Demo Patch #3 - More Bug Fixes and Improved Chinese Localization
notes.content: [h3]Update Summary:[/h3][p]This is a small follow-up patch where we fixed a couple more issues and invited a member of the PROJECT MIX community to improve the quality of the Chinese localization. Thanks, 尘柒![/p][p]For the rest of this month, we'll be focusing on making a Meta Quest 3 standalone demo happen, as well as working on the full game.[/p][p]There will be some more demo bug fixes and refinements next month, so keep an eye out for that. [/p][p]Once again, we won't be adding new "content" to the demo, that's what playing the full game is for.[/p][p][/p][h3]Patch Notes:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where ready-to-drink cans sometimes fell through the counter[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Cliff sometimes didn’t accept the Shaolin beer[/p][/*][*][p]Added button sounds to UI elements and tweaked the volume[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the drink recipe display fonts for Japanese and Simplified Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the text at the end of the demo[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the Chinese localization, thanks to a community member[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where grabbing a handle with two hands would remove one of them[/p][/*][*][p]Added haptic feedback for doors[/p][/*][*][p]Localized more UI elements[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: PROJECT MIX Demo Patch #2 - Bug Fixes, QOL features, and Chinese Localization
notes.content: [h3]Update Summary:[/h3][p]This update focused on fixing a bunch of bugs, improving the back end, and adding quality-of-life features.[/p][p]One notable bug is the one where some players got soft-locked in the bar and couldn't progress. That's now [b]fixed![/b][/p][p][/p][p]We added support for [b]MSAA anti-aliasing[/b], so you can enjoy the game with less flickering. It’s disabled by default, but you’ll find an option to toggle between None, 2x, 4x, and 8x in the System Menu.[/p][p]You’ll also be able to skip the alleyway scene if you’ve already seen it once.[/p][p][/p][p]And last but not least, we added [b]localization support for Simplified Chinese![/b] It’s machine-translated, and not all game elements could be translated, so don’t expect it to be perfect. But it will make the game much more accessible to our Chinese-speaking audience.[/p][p][/p][h3]Will the demo keep receiving updates?[/h3][p]We’re not quite done with bug fixes yet - we’ll continue to do regular maintenance work that will also carry over into the full game. Some small things like UI visuals will also be updated over time. [/p][p]In fact, we will release another small patch early next month to fix a couple of other things.[/p][p][/p][p]However, we won’t be adding new content to the demo because we want to focus on making the full game happen, and this is about as much content as we want to show off in a demo. [/p][p]Buy the full game once it's out to play more and support us![/p][p][/p][h3]Current Status:[/h3][p]Good news — we are now in [b]full production![/b] That means we’re working on content for the full game.[/p][p]We’ve successfully hired a new [b]3D Artist, Programmer, and 2D Graphic Designer[/b] to support us. For a small team like ours, even three extra pairs of hands make a huge difference, since the game has a large number of assets to create.[/p][p]Besides working on the full game, we’re also preparing a demo for [b]standalone Quest users.[/b][/p][p]Keep an eye on our socials to see what we’re up to![/p][p][/p][h3]Patch Notes:[/h3][list][*][p]Added a skip button for the alleyway scene if you've already seen it once[/p][/*][*][p]Added MSAA anti-aliasing drop down in the system menu[/p][/*][*][p]Added haptic feedback to the shower knob[/p][/*][*][p]Added Localization support for Simplified Chinese[/p][/*][*][p]Improved backlog robustness, with author names now colored[/p][/*][*][p]NaniNovel upgraded from 1.19 to 1.20 for improved stability[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the game-breaking bug where some players would get soft-locked in the bar[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed being able to carry items between scenes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the orange skybox briefly appearing when starting the game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed giant cigarette bug[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cat not waking up after too many pats[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the text printer briefly appearing in the corner during the alleyway scene[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the shower knob rotating past 180°[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where you can fly out of the bar rooftop[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If there are any bugs we haven't discovered, feel free to report them on our [url="https://discord.gg/projectmix"]Discord server[/url], which is quite active with over 5500 members. Please join if you haven't![/p]

notes.title: PROJECT MIX Demo Patch #1 - Optimizations and Minor Visual Updates
notes.content: [h3]Update Summary:[/h3][p]Since the Kickstarter, things have been pretty hectic—with personal life events, hiring, production planning, and budgeting keeping our hands full.[/p][p]This update was mainly about making optimizations across the board to help the game run better and move us closer to getting a standalone Quest 3 demo up and running. We also retextured a few assets to improve visual consistency.[/p][p]It’s not the most exciting update, but once our hiring is sorted, we’ll be able to properly focus on the game itself. The release date for the Quest 3 demo is still to be decided, but we’re aiming to have it out before the end of the year.[/p][p][/p][h3]Current Status:[/h3][p]Right now, we’re hiring a 3D Artist, a Programmer, and a 2D Graphic Designer. Once they’re on board, development will be much more manageable, and we’ll be able to ensure the full game keeps the same quality—or better—than what you’ve seen in the demo.[/p][p]While there won’t be any “content updates” to the demo (since we need to focus on the full game), we may continue to push small improvements over time—optimizations, bug fixes, and updated assets here and there.[/p][p]For those who don't know, we also reached the US $200K stretch goal - so it's confirmed that Shoji Meguro will be a guest composer![/p][p][/p][h3]Patch Notes:[/h3][list][*][p]Reduced draw calls—every scene now has fewer than 300 draw calls in VR.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the memory footprint of each scene by an average of 28%.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved texturing on several models in the alleyway for better visual consistency and style.[/p][/*][*][p]Began work on new background NPCs for the bar that better match the game’s style and are more optimized.[/p][/*][*][p]Valencia's tattoo updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where audio was not ducking during the alleyway tutorial due to poor Addressables structuring.[/p][/*][*][p]Added cup sliding mechanics and improved cup colliders.[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded the cat noodle-eating mechanics.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved light probes affecting the bedroom sliding doors to not look so out of place.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed pink ice in beer mug.[/p][/*][/list][p]If there are any bugs we haven't discovered, feel free to report them on our [url="https://discord.gg/projectmix"]Discord server[/url], which is quite active with over 5000 members. Please join if you haven't![/p]

notes.title: PROJECT MIX Kickstarter Campaign is over! Overwhelming Success!

In the end - we reached [b]$189,681[/b], which is slightly short of the next next goal.

However, good news - we've enabled late pledges for a week, so there's still a good chance to hit it!
I believe we can get Meguro-san on the team.

Overall, the Kickstarter campaign went really well.
We hit all the essential stretch goals and more. Plus, the next stretch goal is within reach through late pledges!

Of course, I put a lot of effort into marketing the campaign too, but it's mostly thanks to the community that this went so well.

Thanks again to everyone who believed enough to support the project.

If you know anyone who missed the chance to pledge, please let them know about late pledging so we can have Shoji Meguro as a guest composer. [/p][p]We're already [b]$190,912 [/b]as we speak, so just $9K away.[/p][p]

notes.title: PROJECT MIX Fully Crowdfunded in 54 Minutes - Onto the Stretch Goals!
notes.content:
We just made history. In less than an hour, we have reached USD $50K, our base goal! 

We smashed that goal like NOTHING - this is literally unheard of for a VR game, definitely never happened to a VR anime game!!! 

Thanks, everyone for your support - it's crazy and almost too much for me to process. This is truly a phenomenon.
What a relief that I can officially say the project won't have to get scrapped.

For those who weren't there, here's a time-lapse of it in action!! 

There's still 30 days to go, let's smash some of those stretch goals too while we're at it! That was a dope launch party too.


And the link to the Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/plectrumsoft/project-mix-upcoming-vr-indie-title-inspired-by-90s-anime
